mentions.name: Aethas
mentions.description: Aethas is a personal AI assistant that preps context before meetings, sets reminders, makes design drafts, summarizes meetings, and drafts follow-up emails automatically. It aims to act as a Jarvis-like AI that shares the user's context and acts on it without being asked, using Obsidian for knowledge, Claude for reasoning, and written notes as data sources.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an AI (Aethas, https://blog.aethas.ai) that preps context before my meetings, sets reminders, makes design drafts, summarizes meetings, and drafts follow-up emails without me asking. Basically trying to have an entire personal AI like Jarvis that has the same context as me but acts on it automatically.
